domain_setting: A calm clothing studio with garment silhouettes, fabric swatches, fitting moments, and modest getting-dressed scenes.
recurring_scale_anchors: 304x192 cards with garment contours inside x=24..280 and y=16..176
Garment parts use a muted whole with one rich-color target when the vocabulary names a single component
Textile patterns are large enough to read at 152x96; irregular spots stay distinct from even polka dots
Dressing scenes stay modest and show clothing over normal underlayers
Use different garment silhouettes and palettes to separate nearby clothing terms

polysemy_resolution_table.dress: The verb: an adult helps a fully clothed child put on a jacket, matching the Japanese gloss and clothing group.
polysemy_resolution_table.uniform: A standard outfit worn by a school or work group, despite the adjective gloss.
polysemy_resolution_table.tie (clothing): A necktie garment, distinguished from the verb tie by the clothing group.
polysemy_resolution_table.dressing gown: A loose, long indoor robe worn over sleep clothes; visually distinct from the bathrobe garment card.
polysemy_resolution_table.spotted: Irregular organic spots on cloth, not evenly spaced polka dots.
polysemy_resolution_table.styles: Visible clothing styles shown as different garment silhouettes, not abstract art style.
polysemy_resolution_table.do up: Close a jacket zipper from bottom to top; fasten is the belt buckle and undo is opening a zipper.
polysemy_resolution_table.get changed: A person completes an outfit change in a fitting room, not merely pulling on one garment.
polysemy_resolution_table.suit (someone): Clothing that flatters a person in color and style, separate from the size fit concept.
polysemy_resolution_table.unfasten: Open a shirt cuff button, separate from undoing a zipper and fastening a belt.

contrast_notes.dress / put on / change clothes / get ch: Dress shows one person helping another; put on shows pulling on one garment; change clothes shows outfit choice; get changed shows a completed personal outfit change; take off shows removal.
contrast_notes.bathrobe / dressing gown / pajamas: Keep robes distinct from two-piece sleepwear through silhouette and use scene.
contrast_notes.jockey shorts / boxer shorts / panties /: Use clear garment boundaries, coverage lengths, foot coverage, and waist bands so similar garments remain distinguishable.
contrast_notes.checked / polka dot / spotted / striped: Show checks, even circles, irregular spots, parallel stripes, and a solid unpatterned fabric as separate surface patterns.
contrast_notes.fasten / do up / undo / unfasten: Use a belt buckle, zipper closed, zipper opened, and shirt cuff button opened respectively.
contrast_notes.fit / suit someone / size: Fit refers to garment measurements, suit someone to flattering appearance, and size to a measurable clothing range.
